title: Upcoming flood of REAL AI-slob FMVs on Steam?
author: DoctaRoboto
selftext:
First of all, I am not an AI game dev; I love AI (despite being a traditional painter, some probably already remember me talking about that), and I am really curious about how it is slowly transforming the entertainment landscape.

When AI video-generators like Seedance and Kling 3 appeared I was wondering, why is nobody doing FMV games? I really love old-school 90s FMV games, and there is a lot of hidden potential still in the genre. I am already seeing some attempts at that here in the group, like Project: Acheron. So I went and took a look at Steam, wondering if someone was already planning to launch their game...and oh boy! I had a really nasty surprise.

There are MANY upcoming FMV games on Steam...and they are NOT good, and I'm being very kind. They all look and feel like what Anti-AI people think AI-generated games are: lazy, crappy, cash-grab low-effort trash, mainly from Chinese devs.

And I am really sorry, if any of the devs are here in the group too, but they are just nonsensical cheap shit, to the point I suspect maybe the devs are planning to hide some virus inside the exe or trying to use my graphic card for mining something, I mean there is NO WAY any of these games will sell.

These are some of them, but there are MORE if you look for upcoming FMV games on Steam.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4368630/Hells\_Beasts\_Yama\_Wanted\_Me\_Dead\_I\_Left\_Him\_HalfDead/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4368630/Hells_Beasts_Yama_Wanted_Me_Dead_I_Left_Him_HalfDead/)

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4377020/Iron\_Coffin\_Ice\_Queen\_Her\_Gaze\_Awakens\_My\_Beast/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4377020/Iron_Coffin_Ice_Queen_Her_Gaze_Awakens_My_Beast/)

Or you can check the "Patient Zero" profile, the "studio" (a guy in China, probably) that has published most of these "games":

[https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=OKE.FX%20GROUP](https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=OKE.FX%20GROUP)

I don't want to shame them or expose them. I want you to show me what you can do with all these AI fancy tools you have, but if this trend continues, you are all screwed even before finishing your games, not just FMV games, all AI-generated games. You're already playing on hard mode: your games will be review-bombed by Anti-AI people the moment you get some attention, no streamer will dare to play an AI-generated game...and on top of that, this.

So what are your thoughts? I think this will end up negatively impacting you: non-anti-AI gamers will start blocking or avoiding any game that smells like AI, and Steam will make it harder for you to publish AI-generated content.

I want to end the post with a more positive note. Another AI FMV game that is putting SOME efford in their game. Another Chinese dev, but it seems they at least have some decency. It looks like some kind of Detroit: Become Human mixed with Blade Runner and Deus Ex. I still think they could put some efford on trying to have a UNIQUE aesthetic (I am honestly tired of the Flux/Illustrious/GPT aesthetics, put some more efford, guys, visuals are key, this comes from a veteran painter), but at least all scenes and characters seem consistent, and the guy is trying to tell a story.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4786090/Memory\_Ember/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4786090/Memory_Ember/)

And no, this is not self-promoting, I am not Chinese, and I have no freaking idea about how any of this stuff works. I only use Perchance to do some roleplay fun, and I use ComfyUI and Forge to do crazy arsty stuff.

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: Who cares? Some people will get better at making them with practice. Then the players who enjoy the genre will have more options.

comments.author: imnotabot303
comments.body:
AI games are becoming a bit like the asset flip period. For a few years platforms were flooded with low effort asset flip games.

It's basically people thinking they are getting in on a gold rush, however once people realise their low effort mostly AI game is not going to make them rich and those games start to quickly sink to the bottom, a lot of people will lose interest and eventually move on.

replies.author: Environmental_Top948
replies.body: When did assets flips stop happening because my steam page is full of them?

replies.author: imnotabot303
replies.body:
They didn't, but they have reduced a lot from when it was at it's peak. Steam was flooded with them at one point.

That's one reason Steam changed from their Greenlight system. The previous system was one payment and then you could upload as many games as you wanted. People were flooding the place with slop so they made it per game.

comments.author: lesuperhun
comments.body:
i don't know, how about asking an ai for it ?

all jokes asides : 

you stumbled upon the reason why anti-ai are anti-ai : because it makes good quality games/art buried under layers and layers of slop. (that, and ecological reasons)

also, anti ai don't review bomb. they just ignore ai games. because review bombing implies buying the game.  
if a game gets review bombed because of ai, it's likely because it either wasn't disclosed, or because it's just slop.

and for the others customers ?

low effort games and unity slop have always existed. ai is just the latest flavor of slop.

and a side remark : 

>but at least all scenes and characters seem consistent, and the guy is trying to tell a story.

that is, and to put it lightly, a VERY LOW bar. having consistent characters is well under the bare minimum necessary. 

even good old unity asset slop had character consistency. let's not define that as a quality mark. it is well under the bare minimum for a game.

replies.author: DoctaRoboto
replies.body: I just wanted to end the post on a positive note. Yeah, this Memory Ember game STILL looks lackluster to me, but compared to the other shit I posted, it's like a Kojima game. I just didn't want to come up as a hater. I really love FMVs, and I want you guys to do something better than this trash.

replies.author: Shalcker
replies.body: Obviously solution to discoverability of gems within piles of slop that is no longer gated by efforts are tireless AI game curators.

comments.author: StickStill9790
comments.body:
I’ve said it before, we need a new “Nintendo Seal of Quality” for game systems. 

It’s not even about AI. There’s so much junk on every App Store that finding anything worthwhile is impossible, and selling anything is a Sisyphean nightmare.

replies.author: LeafyWolf
replies.body: I could probably make an AI Agent that crawls through the Steam store looking for quality signals and flags slop.  Ideally, you could put some features you want from the game, and it could give you a short list.  Stretch goal is that it plays it for a bit to validate, and then returns it.  Hmmm ..I wonder if there's a way to work with Steam to facilitate that.

comments.author: Overhaul20
comments.body: I dunno man. Why waste time and even bother?

comments.author: Turbulent-Armadillo9
comments.body: I mean I am a little concerned that finding good games is going to be absolutely chaos in 6 months to a year or whatever. Indie gaming is going to get so weird. Maybe people will build ai tools to sift thru steam and give suggestions of games that seem like things humans may enjoy.

replies.author: DoctaRoboto
replies.body:
This is one of my points as someone who is very curious about what you guys can do. People saying this doesn't matter can't see the big picture here. Like another user pointed out, Steam changed their policies due to the amount of asset-flipped games, and instead of one payment per dev, it became one payment per game. 

That is why you people should be worried. If this shit continues growing, Steam will make it harder for you to make AI games. How can you not see that?

replies.author: Nervous_Teach_5596
replies.body: And you haven't touched the worst part, you can do vaporware in a snap, yet the industry will do something as it has always done

comments.author: Sakubo0018
comments.body: Most of them are visual novels me who  loves playing visual novels tried some  AI VN but they are terrible low effort and majority of them are despite having good art its uncanny and feels detached in the scene, flat and the Event CG has no story telling. I'm not an anti since I have my own local AI desktop companion which I've build but as a visual novel lover those are definitely slops the early 2000's VN are still better.
